calibration_sources: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report: 1x128 Activation Tile & 128x128 Weight Block FP8 Training + Nc=128 CUDA Core FP32 Accumulation Promotion
Hopper H100/H200 Tensor Core WGMMA 13-bit Mantissa Accumulator Precision Analysis
OCP Microscaling Formats (MXFP8 / NVFP4) + Hadamard Outlier Rotation & Stochastic Rounding Pretraining Model

tiers.name: Tier 1: Standard BF16 Mixed Precision (BF16 GEMM + FP32 Master Weights & Accumulator)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 1: 标准 BF16 混合精度训练 (BF16 矩阵乘 + FP32 主权重与累加)
tiers.scaling_granularity: None (8-bit Exponent E8M7 covers 10^-38 to 10^38 dynamic range natively)
tiers.accumulator_precision: Full IEEE FP32 (23-bit Mantissa inside Tensor Core)

tiers.name: Tier 2: Coarse Per-Tensor Delayed-Scaling FP8 (1st-Gen TransformerEngine Hybrid E4M3/E5M2)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 2: 粗粒度 Per-Tensor 延迟缩放 FP8 (初代单张量全局 amax 历史窗口)
tiers.scaling_granularity: Per-Tensor (1 scale per [M, K] matrix using historical amax window)
tiers.accumulator_precision: Hopper WGMMA 13-bit Mantissa (Suffers K-dimension accumulation drift)

tiers.name: Tier 3: Fine-Grained Tile/Block FP8 (DeepSeek-V3 1x128 Act Tile + 128x128 Weight Block + FP32 CUDA Core Promotion)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 3: 细粒度分块缩放 FP8 (DeepSeek-V3 1×128 激活切片 + 128×128 权重块 + CUDA 核 FP32 累加提升)
tiers.accumulator_precision: Promotes WGMMA partial sums to CUDA Core FP32 (23-bit) every Nc=128 elements

tiers.name: Tier 4: Blackwell Hardware Microscaling (MXFP8 1x32 / Hybrid NVFP4 1x16 + Hadamard Rotation + Stochastic Rounding)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 4: Blackwell 原生硬件微缩放 (MXFP8 1×32 / 混合 NVFP4 1×16 + 哈达玛旋转 + 随机舍入)
tiers.scaling_granularity: Hardware Tensor Core 1x32 E8M0 (MXFP8) & 1x16 E4M3 (NVFP4) Micro-Blocks
tiers.accumulator_precision: Native 5th-Gen Tensor Core Micro-Block Scaling + Hardware Stochastic Rounding

outlier_accumulation_perturbation.condition: Late-Stage MoE Expert Router Spike (Outlier Ratio 1,000x, K=16384)
